B.domain: Arithmetic with rational numbers (fraction and mixed-number subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed numbers to improper fractions
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number as an equivalent improper fraction by converting the whole part into fractional units and adding the fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly converts a mixed number (e.g., 3 1/2) into an improper fraction (e.g., 7/2)
A step rewrites a nonstandard mixed form like 2 3/2 as a sum (2 + 3/2) and then as an improper fraction
exclusion_criteria: Only converting a whole number to a fraction with a chosen denominator (tag S03 instead)
Only converting an improper fraction to a mixed number (tag S06 instead)

skills.name: Find and use a common denominator (equivalent fractions)
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step finds a common denominator or LCM for two denominators
A step scales numerators/denominators to express fractions with the same denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already the same and the step directly subtracts numerators (tag S04 instead)
Only simplifying a fraction by reducing (tag S05 instead)

skills.name: Rewrite whole numbers as fractions with a specified denominator
skills.definition: Express an integer as an equivalent fraction with a given denominator to enable fraction subtraction (e.g., 3 = 15/5).
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites an integer as k/k-denominator form (e.g., 2 = 6/3, 4 = 12/3)
The denominator is chosen to match another fraction’s denominator for subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Converting a mixed number to an improper fraction (tag S01 instead)
Finding a common denominator between two non-integer fractions (tag S02 instead)

skills.name: Subtract fractions once denominators match
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two fractions with the same denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator (including recognizing identical fractions subtract to 0).
inclusion_criteria: A step performs subtraction like a/b − c/b = (a−c)/b
A step subtracts identical fractions to get 0
exclusion_criteria: A step is primarily about creating equivalent fractions/common denominators (tag S02 instead)
A step is primarily about reducing/simplifying the result (tag S05 instead)

skills.name: Simplify/reduce fractions to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor and/or recognizing when a fraction is already in lowest terms.
inclusion_criteria: A step simplifies a fraction (e.g., −3/12 = −1/4)
A step states the fraction is already in lowest terms
exclusion_criteria: Converting an improper fraction to a mixed number without reducing (tag S06 instead)
Only performing subtraction without simplification (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Convert improper fractions to mixed numbers or integers
skills.definition: Rewrite an improper fraction as a mixed number (or as an integer when the numerator is a multiple of the denominator).
inclusion_criteria: A step converts a/b (with a>b) into a mixed number
A step converts a/a into 1 or identifies 0 as an integer result
exclusion_criteria: Converting mixed numbers to improper fractions (tag S01 instead)
Only reducing a fraction without converting to mixed/integer form (tag S05 instead)

C.domain: Arithmetic with rational numbers (fraction and mixed-number subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed numbers to improper fractions
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number as an equivalent improper fraction by multiplying the whole number by the denominator and adding the numerator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly converts a mixed number (e.g., 3 1/2) into an improper fraction (e.g., 7/2)
A step rewrites a nonstandard mixed form like 2 3/2 as a sum (2 + 3/2) and then as an improper fraction
exclusion_criteria: Only rewriting a whole number as a fraction with a chosen denominator (e.g., 3 = 15/5)
Only converting an improper fraction to a mixed number

skills.name: Rewrite whole numbers as equivalent fractions
skills.definition: Express an integer as a fraction with a specified denominator to enable fraction operations (e.g., 3 = 15/5).
inclusion_criteria: A step writes an integer as an equivalent fraction with a target denominator (e.g., 2 = 16/8, 4 = 12/3)
The denominator is chosen to match or become a common denominator for subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Converting a mixed number to an improper fraction
Finding an LCM or converting between two fractional denominators without an integer being rewritten

skills.name: Find a common denominator (LCM) and create equivalent fractions
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step identifies a common denominator or LCM for two denominators
A step scales numerators/denominators to produce equivalent fractions with the common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already the same and no conversion is needed
Only simplifying a fraction after subtraction

skills.name: Subtract fractions with a common denominator
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two fractions that share a denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step performs subtraction after fractions have the same denominator (including cases where they started the same)
A step simplifies a result like 8/8 to 1 as part of the subtraction outcome
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator without performing the subtraction
Subtracting whole and fractional parts separately as mixed numbers (without converting to a single fraction)

skills.name: Subtract mixed numbers by separating whole and fractional parts
skills.definition: Compute a mixed-number difference by subtracting whole-number parts and fractional parts (including handling a negative fractional difference) and recombining.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly decomposes mixed numbers into (whole part) + (fractional part) and subtracts those parts
A step recombines the resulting whole and fractional parts into a single value
exclusion_criteria: Converting mixed numbers to improper fractions and then subtracting as fractions
Only converting between improper fraction and mixed number after subtraction

skills.name: Simplify and format the result (reduce, convert to mixed/whole number)
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms and/or convert between improper fraction, mixed number, and whole number representations for the final answer.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction (e.g., −3/12 = −1/4) or states it is already in lowest terms
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number (or a fraction like 3/3 to 1) for final reporting
exclusion_criteria: Creating equivalent fractions to reach a common denominator (that is S03)
Performing the core subtraction operation (that is S04 or S05)

A.domain: Arithmetic with rational numbers (fraction and mixed-number subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed numbers to improper fractions
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number as an equivalent improper fraction by multiplying the whole part by the denominator and adding the numerator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly converts a mixed number (e.g., 3 1/2) into an improper fraction (e.g., 7/2)
A step rewrites a nonstandard mixed form like 2 3/2 as 2 + 3/2 and then as an improper fraction
exclusion_criteria: Only converting a whole number to a fraction with a chosen denominator (tag S03 instead)
Only simplifying a fraction (tag S06 instead)
Only converting an improper fraction to a mixed number (tag S05 instead)

skills.name: Find and use a common denominator (LCM) to create equivalent fractions
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step states or implies finding a common denominator/LCM for two denominators
A step scales numerators/denominators to rewrite fractions with the common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and the work only subtracts numerators (tag S04 instead)
Only rewriting a whole number as a fraction with a specified denominator (tag S03 instead)

skills.name: Rewrite a whole number as an equivalent fraction
skills.definition: Express an integer as a fraction with a specified denominator (e.g., 3 = 15/5) to enable fraction subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites an integer as k/k-denominator form (e.g., 2 = 6/3, 4 = 12/3, 2 = 16/8)
exclusion_criteria: Converting a mixed number to an improper fraction (tag S01 instead)
Finding a common denominator between two non-integer fractions (tag S02 instead)

skills.name: Subtract fractions using a common denominator
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two fractions by subtracting numerators while keeping the common denominator (including the already-same-denominator case).
inclusion_criteria: A step performs subtraction after fractions have the same denominator (e.g., 20/12 − 9/12)
A step explicitly notes denominators are the same and subtracts numerators (e.g., (6−4)/7)
exclusion_criteria: The step is only about finding/converting to a common denominator (tag S02 instead)
The step is only simplifying the resulting fraction (tag S06 instead)
The step is only converting to mixed number form (tag S05 instead)

skills.name: Convert an improper fraction to a mixed number (or whole number)
skills.definition: Rewrite an improper fraction as a mixed number or integer by dividing the numerator by the denominator and expressing the remainder as a fraction.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly converts an improper fraction to a mixed number (e.g., 7/4 = 1 3/4, 5/3 = 1 2/3)
A step converts a fraction equal to 1 (e.g., 8/8) into the integer 1
exclusion_criteria: Converting mixed to improper (tag S01 instead)
Only simplifying a fraction without changing to mixed form (tag S06 instead)

skills.name: Simplify a fraction to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor and/or recognizing when it is already in lowest terms.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction (e.g., −3/12 = −1/4, 4/10 = 2/5)
A step states the result is already in lowest terms
exclusion_criteria: Only converting between mixed and improper forms (tag S01 or S05 instead)
Only performing the subtraction operation (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Subtract mixed numbers by separating whole and fractional parts
skills.definition: Compute a mixed-number difference by subtracting whole parts and fractional parts (including handling a negative fractional difference) and recombining.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly decomposes mixed numbers into (whole difference) + (fraction difference), e.g., (4−2) + (4/12−7/12)
A step recombines the whole and fractional results into a single mixed number or improper fraction
exclusion_criteria: Method uses only conversion to improper fractions followed by fraction subtraction (tag S01 + S04 instead)
Only converting to mixed number at the end without decomposing the subtraction (tag S05 instead)
